source_text: Si Paulo lex spiritalis, et benedictiones spiritales. Non solum terrae fructus sed animae victoria.
pass_a_gloss: If to-Paul law spiritual, also blessings spiritual. Not only of-earth fruits but of-soul victory.
pass_b_english: If for Paul the [[law is spiritual >> Bible:Romans 7:14]], so are the blessings — not only earth’s fruit but the soul’s victory.
